note: Copy to config.prod.json and replace every myserver.chat with your domain -- the same one you put in deploy/.env. Every setting is explained in server/docs/config.md.
note-mail: Mailpit, so nobody has to set up SMTP. Magic links land at https://myserver.chat/mailpit, behind the password in .env. To send real mail instead, point these at your provider (see server/docs/email.md) and drop the mailpit service from compose.prod.yml.
note-whitelist: Uncomment to run invite-only. Checked fresh on every use -- no restart needed to add an address.
